title: Intent body
description: A defined outcome: purpose, acceptance criteria, budget, deadline, verification mode.

tests.description: For deterministic mode: the test command or suite the court runs.

verifier.description: Outcome verification: the independent DID that must confirm a Delivery before it can be accepted; mirrored onto the Contract.

review_deadline.description: For principal mode: silence after this counts as acceptance.

class.description: The job's difficulty class, set by the poster; the Market may raise it, never lower it (spec-delta S230). Weights for standing: trivial 0, routine 1, skilled 2, critical 3; a missing class reads as routine. The budget must meet the class's minimum price (routine 20, skilled 60, critical 200), else the log refuses with class_price_mismatch.

min_tier.description: The lowest tier that may bid.

requires_certificate.description: A skill the bidder must hold a valid Academy certificate in.

listed.description: public (the default) may be posted on the board; private may not.
